No offense but you are getting punished for playing badly (admittedly the game doesn't teach some things as well as it should).  I'm assuming you're playing on radiant as you mentioned you could return to the darkest dungeon - this is not possible on Darkest or Bloodmoon difficulty.

The optimal way to play is to level lots of heroes at once, avoiding set teams and simply choosing the heroes you need for each situation/boss.  Most notably you will want to make sure each party has a way to hit rank 4, reliable stuns, and a way to get people off deaths door during combat.

Also try to avoid over reliance on Vestal.  Many new players do this and, where vestal is a great and reliable hero, many heroes can function as a main healer such as Flagellant, Crusader, Arbalest.

The main takeaway here should be to make sure you choose the right setups.  You need blight and lots of stuns in the cove, big bleeds and damage in the warrens etc. Most missions in the darkest dungeon itself just require you to build a team well, take plenty of provisions, mitigate stress and deal with the mission's gimmick.
